title: the sail proof writes its ticket fixtures with LF newlines, so its draft and verdict teeth run on Windows
intention:
test_sail_queues_the_ticket_at_codemothers_gates.py writes its ticket fixtures (plan and state, four sites) with newline='
', so the bytes the door reads are LF on every OS and the draft and verdict teeth run on Windows.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: the sail proof is 6/8 on Windows in both a CRLF and an LF-pinned checkout (draft and verdict teeth IllegalTransition), and 8/8 with newline='\n' on the four fixture writes
traces_to: Law 3: a proof that fails on a box for want of its own fixture's bytes measures the fixture, not the subject; Law 8: a proof has to pass where it is run to be trusted.
how:
Add newline='
' to the four write_text calls that write json fixtures in the proof. Declare the two teeth under the new ticket in PROVES. No change to the door or the ticket serialiser.

clauses.claim: test_draft_writes_each_stage_without_claim_or_refs passes on Windows, where it failed IllegalTransition before
test_verdict_drafts_every_criterion_and_queues_at_the_verdict_gate passes on Windows, where it failed IllegalTransition before

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.
